body:
Build 2.7.0: **Flight Protocol**

- **Flight Protocol, a new flying mode.** PLAY > FLIGHT PROTOCOL. Launch from a pad (engines charge, 3-2-1), fly through checkpoint rings, collect energy for boost, shoot enemy drones and dodge each route's hazards. Flown with your selected mech.
- **Four routes:** Cloudbreaker Route (above Arcadium City, storm clouds and lightning), Titan Canyon (narrow canyons, collapsing rocks), Reactor Corridor (laser barriers, rotating blades) and Orbital Ring (the edge of space, boost gates).
- **Air boss: the Sky Leviathan.** Chase it through the clouds, shoot out its engines, fly inside it and destroy the core.
- **Pilot ranks and challenges.** Every run is scored on time, rings, energy, drones and damage, and earns a rank from Bronze Pilot to Titan Pilot. Each route has three challenges: under par, every ring, no damage. Best runs are kept on your device.
- **Engine trails.** Six trail colours, unlocked by pilot rank (visual only).
- **New music.** "Ironvale Overdrive" in the menus and on the results screen, "Ironvale WAR" in fights.

**Install:** on Windows, run `Ironvale_Setup.exe`. On Android, install `Ironvale.apk`. In a browser, play at https://ironvale.gmicrosystem.com/play/ (Wildlands needs the PC or Android version).

`wildlands_v1.ivmp`, `dunesea_v1.ivmp` and `frostpeak_v1.ivmp` are the Wildlands worlds. The game downloads them for you.

2.6.1 and 2.7 players can play online together (the network protocol did not change).
name: Ironvale 2.7.0: Flight Protocol

body:
Build 2.6.1: **Faster Fights**

- **The whole game is faster.** Mechs move, turn and stop quicker, shots fly faster, dashes recharge sooner, and you are back in the fight in about 5 seconds instead of 8.
- **Kills really are faster now.** In 2.6.0 the new ammo slowed long fights down. Main attacks now refill quicker, so a test match that took about 143 seconds in 2.5 (and 163 in 2.6.0) takes about 90.
- **The elements are stronger.** Ignis, Terra, Maelstrom and Zephyr have 45% more hull and hit 45% harder. Against Aether they take half damage and deal double, so Aether finally has rivals.
- **Online fix: shock wave supers.** A shock wave super used by anyone but the host did no damage. Fixed.
- **Online fix: hits after a dash.** Hits on a mech that had just dashed were sometimes thrown away. Fixed.
- **Sharper shadows** on HIGH graphics on PC, and smoother matches (less memory churn every frame).
- **Mech Designer polish.** Long evolved names no longer overlap in MECHS.

**Install:** on Windows, run `Ironvale_Setup.exe`. On Android, install `Ironvale.apk`. In a browser, play at https://ironvale.gmicrosystem.com/play/ (Wildlands needs the PC or Android version).

`wildlands_v1.ivmp`, `dunesea_v1.ivmp` and `frostpeak_v1.ivmp` are the Wildlands worlds. The game downloads them for you.

2.6.0 players can't join 2.6.1 matches: everyone needs 2.6.1.
name: Ironvale 2.6.1: Faster Fights

body:
Build 2.6.0: **Design Your Own Mech**

- **Mech Designer.** Own every mech (Aether and the elementals included) and you can design your own: pick a body, an attack, a heavy weapon, a dash and a super from any mech in the game (ADMIN?!?! excluded), and name it. It joins your collection like any other mech: upgrade it, evolve it to V4, paint it with Skins and take it online. Every custom mech has a Legendary hull. To design another one, get your last design to power 9 and V4. Open it from MECHS > DESIGN A MECH.
- **Main attacks hit 60% harder**, so fights end faster. In exchange, main attacks now use ammo: about 2.5 seconds of fire, refilling one round at a time. The weapon never locks while it refills, so you can keep firing whatever is loaded. Your ammo shows on the attack button.
- **Skill-based matchmaking.** Quick match now looks for players of a similar skill first, then widens the search.
- **Upgrades give perks.** Power 3: super charges 10% faster. Power 5: dash recharges 10% faster. Power 7: main attack refills 15% faster. Power 9: 2 extra main-attack rounds.
- **Evolution Trial bosses are easier.** 15% less hull and damage, one clone summoned at a time and at most three alive.
- **Honest menu.** Online and arena matches never pause, so their menu now says MENU and "the match keeps going". Campaign missions still pause.

**Install:** on Windows, run `Ironvale_Setup.exe`. On Android, install `Ironvale.apk`. In a browser, play at https://ironvale.gmicrosystem.com/play/ (Wildlands needs the PC or Android version).

`wildlands_v1.ivmp`, `dunesea_v1.ivmp` and `frostpeak_v1.ivmp` are the Wildlands worlds. The game downloads them for you.

name: Ironvale 2.6.0: Design Your Own Mech

body:
Build 2.5.0: **Evolution**

- **Mechs evolve.** Buying gears is gone. Every mech now has four forms, V1 to V4. Each form adds hull and damage, and V4 also adds super charge, dash recharge and speed. You can see the form on the mech: a glowing ring, then orbiting shards, then a crown.
- **Your gears carry over.** A gear you already bought counts as V2. Nothing you paid for is lost.
- **Evolution Trials.** At max power, take your mech's trial with the mech itself: four islands of echoes of your own mech, then its boss on the fifth island. You have three lives. Win, and the mech evolves in a cinematic on the home screen.
- **Holoforge's Hall of Reflections.** Holoforge has its own trial. On one island, only one reflection is real.
- **Trials with friends.** Start a trial while you host a party, and up to four of you take it together. Every extra pilot adds an echo to each island and makes the echoes and the boss tougher. Friends flying the same mech, ready for the same trial, evolve too.
- **Better basic training.** The training bot now starts close by, and a red arrow at the edge of the screen (with the distance) always points to it. The walk lesson leads you straight to it.
- **Trophy Road page.** Five districts to climb, from the home-screen pilot card or ROAD in the side menu.
- **Aim sensitivity** for Showdown, per mouse, touch and gamepad (Settings).

**Install:** on Windows, run `Ironvale_Setup.exe`. On Android, install `Ironvale.apk`. In a browser, play at https://ironvale.gmicrosystem.com/play/ (Wildlands needs the PC or Android version).

Build 2.4.1: **All 43 mechs rebuilt**

- **New mech models.** Every mech and Holoforge has a brand-new detailed model made in Blender: bolts, rivets, gears, hoses, vents, hazard stripes and a face screen on every mech. Holoforge is now a six-rotor drone with spinning rotors.
- **Real metal.** Steel parts shine and reflect like metal on PC and most phones (every graphics setting except LOW; the browser version keeps the 2.4 look).
- **Better firing animations.** Arms kick back and up on every shot, barrels slide back into the gun, and missile pods jolt when they fire.
- **Missiles leave their tubes.** Rockets and missiles launch from the mech's own pods with a puff of smoke and a short climb, and now have a nose and fins.
- **Straight tracers.** Bullets fly straight out of the barrel instead of dipping after they leave it.
- **More damage.** Every mech hits about 35% harder, so fights end sooner.

body:
Build 2.4.0: **Creator Update: map creator, practice and share links**

- **Map Creator.** Build your own arena inside the real arena. Pick a block from the bar (wall, crate, pillar, low barrier, bush or eraser), then click or drag to place it. Right-click erases. On phones, one finger places and two fingers move and zoom.
  - Every block is mirrored for the other side (or all four sides on Showdown maps), so every map is fair.
  - Blue rings show spawns, repair canisters and objectives. Cover can't go there, and maps that seal an area off are refused.
  - Pick the size (Duel, Duos or Squads arena) and one of the six looks. Save up to 30 maps on your device.
  - **PLAY IT** to fight on your map against bots, in practice or in a private room. Matches against bots on your own map play as friendly matches.
- **Practice.** Any mode, any mech (except the Godly humans and ADMIN?!?!), with everyone at full level. Choose how many pilots there are and set each slot to a bot (pick its mech), a slot open for a friend, or empty. Nothing is won or lost: no rewards, trophies, rank or quest changes.
- **Share links.** SHARE LINK copies a link to your map: anyone can open it in the browser or in the app. Hosts can share a room link that joins straight in.
- **Always up to date.** From this version on, when a new update is out, older copies show a DOWNLOAD NEW VERSION screen instead of letting you play.
- **Basic training.** New pilots learn the controls step by step in an easy first duel.
- **Wildlands.** Lakes are water: mechs wade, slow down and splash. Enterable buildings, power cube chests, and a dropship with an opening cargo ramp. Jetpacks sit on the mech's back.
- **New models.** Cover, power cube chests, jetpacks, the repair canister, Crystal Rush crystals and Wildlands buildings, statues, windows and rooftops, all made in Blender.
- **Graphics.** Detailed metal on mechs, realistic ground on HIGH, and a colour grade for each place.
- **Smoother.** Fewer stutters in matches, and phones and browsers lower the resolution a little by themselves when the frame rate drops.

**Install:** on Windows, run `Ironvale_Setup.exe`. On Android, install `Ironvale.apk`. In a browser, play at https://ironvale.gmicrosystem.com/play/ (Wildlands needs the PC or Android version).

body:
Build 2.3.0: **Wildlands, bigger maps and party lobby**

- **Wildlands.** A new 20-pilot Showdown in a 3D world, seen from behind your mech. Pick one of three worlds, each with a picture in the map picker:
  - **Wildlands:** towns, forests and lakes.
  - **Dune Sea:** sandstone towns, cacti and palm oases.
  - **Frostpeak:** snowy villages, frozen lakes and pine woods.

  Each world is a small download (2-5 MB, PC and Android).
- **Dropship drop.** Every Wildlands match starts on a dropship flying over the world. Press JUMP to bail out, then steer down with your jetpack. You can't climb, and weapons come online when you land.
- **Controls.** SPACE (A, or the JUMP button on phones) jumps over low cover. SHIFT (RB) dashes. The mouse stays on the crosshair and turns the camera. Hold ALT to free the mouse.
- **Mechs with faces.** Every mech has a face screen that blinks and smiles ^ ^. It shows > < when hit, stars for a super, hearts for a heart emote and X X when destroyed. Lose, and your own mech shows a sad glitching face, sparks and breaks down on the ground.
- **Better graphics.** A real sky with clouds, grass, glossy water and longer shadows in Wildlands. Detailed mech armour with pulsing glow and energy lines.
- **No minimap.** It gave sneak attacks away. In Wildlands, enemy name tags only show when they are close and in sight.
- **Free mechs for playing.** 15 minutes in matches unlocks Gatling, 30 minutes unlocks Cantor Prime.
- **Bigger random maps.** Every match builds a new map with breakable cover, in six themes. Matches are faster, with a 15 s respawn beside a teammate.
- **Party lobby.** Up to 10 pilots' mechs stand side by side on the home screen. Send emotes (happy, haha, angry, sad, wow, heart) in the lobby and in matches. Invites are more reliable.
- **Voice lines.** Every mech talks when it deploys, uses its super, gets a takedown or goes down (in the PC and Android versions).
- **Graphics LOW / DEFAULT / HIGH.**
- **Fixes.** Big online lobbies now start for everyone who joins, the camera no longer gets stuck or ends up inside trees, and the browser version loads faster.

**Install:** on Windows, run `Ironvale_Setup.exe`. On Android, install `Ironvale.apk`. In a browser, play at https://ironvale.gmicrosystem.com/play/ (Wildlands needs the PC or Android version).

body:
Build 2.0 (build 10) — **Titan Fusion & the Elemental Gauntlet**

### Titan Fusion (new 1v1 mode, online and vs bots)
- Pick five of your mechs (PLAY > TITAN FUSION > PICK 5 MECHS). The first one leads: the titan takes its look and dash.
- When the match starts, your five gather around you, circle faster and faster, dive into the centre and burst out as one **mega titan**: twice the size, with one glowing orb per fused mech.
- The titan fires every pick's attack and heavy weapon at once, and its super fires all of their supers. Its hull is half of all five mechs' hull at their power.
- Your opponent fuses five of their own. First to 2 takedowns, 3 minutes.

### The Elemental Gauntlet
- Own all four elemental mechs and the Elements page opens the **Elemental Gauntlet**: mega Ignis, Terra, Maelstrom and Zephyr, one after another. When the last one falls, **Aether** awakens with every element's power combined.
- You have **10 lives** and 15 minutes.

### Aether, the Fifth Element (Ultra Legendary)
- Beat the Gauntlet and Aether appears in MECHS for 30,000 salvage.
- **Quintessence**: five curving stars that shatter into burning, freezing shards, fired together with all four elemental attacks and heavy weapons. Its Sky Lance super also fires the four elemental supers.
- Four elemental orbs with light trails circle it, shedding fire, earth, water and wind.

### Fixes
- Sentry Drop turrets no longer get mechs that also carry the HV-9 Autocannon flagged by the online referee.
- The match header no longer overlaps the score in modes with long names.

**Install:** on Windows, run `IronvaleProtocol_Setup.exe`. On Android, install `IronvaleProtocol.apk`. In a browser, play at https://ironvale.gmicrosystem.com/play/

1.9 and 2.0 can't play online together, so update to keep playing online. 1.9 copies can update with UPDATE NOW.
name: Ironvale Protocol 2.0 — Titan Fusion & the Elemental Gauntlet

Build 1.9 (build 9) — **Two New Pilots**

### New humans (Godly, hidden until you find them)
- **Sneha, the Starweaver**: Ribbon Stars, twin stars that weave through the air and ricochet off walls. The Supernova Bloom heat-seeker bursts into four stars, and the Mega Mech super calls in an Oracle-frame mega mech.
- **Nayra, the Mirage**: Mirage Daggers, a fan of three daggers that speed up as they fly and pierce the first enemy. The Monsoon heat-seeker fires five slowing rain seekers, and the Mega Mech super calls in a Wraith-frame mega mech.

Both have passive Hacking, their own dash, look and gear, and 4,721 hull like every human. Find them in rare Forged Rewards.

### Also
- The licence now allows using the game's art and names in your own work ([LICENSE.md](https://github.com/Da-coding-pro/IronvaleProtocol-releases/blob/main/LICENSE.md)).

Build 1.8 (build 8) — **Forge & Fury**

### New mechs
- **Jolt, the Livewire** (Rare skirmisher): an Arc Repeater that sprays sparks which jump to a second enemy.
- **Ronin, the Last Blade** (Epic assassin): lunging katana cuts that drain life, with a crescent wave every third cut.
- **Hex, the Curseweaver** (Epic controller): homing Hexbolt Orbs that slow their victims and hop to two more.
- **Wyvern, the Skyfire** (Legendary artillery): volleys of curving Dragonfire missiles that burst into flame.
- **Oblivion, the Void Emperor** (Ultra Legendary void titan): the Event Horizon beam pierces five enemies, drags them in and feeds on them.

Each has its own attack, dash, gear and look.

### Tougher mechs
- **Every mech now has at least 3,500 hull** (at power 1), and every rarity is still tougher than the one below it. Titan Hunt and the Elemental Trial bosses keep their old toughness.

### Forged Rewards
- Chaos Drops are now **Forged Rewards**. Opening one is a blacksmith hammering a glowing ingot on the anvil: every strike throws sparks and can raise the rarity until the reward is forged. Tap to strike faster.

### Music
- A cyberpunk **phonk** beat in the lobby and **fast mecha battle music** in every match.

### Also
- The anti-cheat now counts chain and split shots correctly.
- Copyright notice on the title screen; the game is licensed under the [Ironvale Protocol EULA](https://github.com/Da-coding-pro/IronvaleProtocol-releases/blob/main/LICENSE.md). © 2026 Arcsteel Reactor Studios, all rights reserved.

body:
Build 1.7 (build 7) — **Elementals & Anti-Cheat**

### New
- **Elemental mechs** — Ignis (fire), Terra (earth), Maelstrom (water) and Zephyr (air), the toughest frames in the game. Collect every normal mech to open the **ELEMENTS** page, then beat a 1v1 **Elemental Trial** against a mega titan to unlock each one.
- **Gears** — every mech (except ADMIN?!?!) has its own gear, bought at max power, that adds a signature effect in battle.
- **Dash and victory animations** for the elementals.
- Mechs are harder to earn: prices doubled, trophy unlocks ×1.5.

### Balance
- **Hull now follows rarity**: every mech is tougher than every mech of a lower rarity. Health was raised across the roster (Legendary Nova: 3,567 hull).

### Anti-cheat
- The host now referees every remote player: fire rate, hits per shot, damage per hit, range, super charge and movement. Players caught cheating are removed from the match.
- Protected currency in memory, sealed saves (edited saves are refused), speed-hack and clock checks, and checks against mod loaders, injected DLLs, memory editors, debuggers and repackaged APKs.

### Fixes
- Elements card titles, trial header, camera zoom, collection page layout.

**Install** — Windows: run `IronvaleProtocol_Setup.exe`. Android: install `IronvaleProtocol.apk`. Browser: unzip `IronvaleProtocol_WebGL.zip` onto any web host. 1.6 copies can update with UPDATE NOW.
name: Ironvale Protocol 1.7 — Elementals
